title: Clearer API key guidance
summary:
A documentation cleanup made API keys, model names, and first requests easier to navigate.

The README and website now explain publishable and secret keys with request examples and guidance on restricting keys to specific models.

API docs now show primary model names instead of aliases, and the chat completions schema lists available text models. AWS Nova Micro is listed as `nova-fast`; `nova-micro` still works as an alias.

The new organization profile includes quick starts for image, text, and chat requests. The main README now has clearer navigation and explains how contributors can earn Pollen.
